native_launch_failures.run_exit_code_reason: Original artifact runner shared a report with reference producer; preserve console and raw process logs, do not invent lost per-case exit fields.

fault_schedule_amendment.reason: The first fixed reference trial missed its intended interrupted/released state coverage: partial dwell was only 0.10s, release had not happened at 12.2s. Retain all failures. Freeze follow-up fault schedules from the already viewed healthy timing; no unseen-data claim.

required_checks.storage_policy: Retain every current raw byte in immutable verified archives and every historical byte in original immutable backups. Do not restore duplicate mutable live outputs in this constrained workspace.

comparative_maturity.basis: Subjective planning/scope estimate retained: fixed stop-rule recovery and native composition strengthen the authored simulation domain; automotive 30% waypoint remains unmet.

physical_hold_measurement_scope.first_fulfillment: The frozen 1 m minimum unreleased physical-front margin applies until each sign first satisfies the independent physical stop rule. Physical satisfaction persists across localization epochs.
physical_hold_measurement_scope.post_reset_reconfirmation: Previously served signs rearmed by the driver require a new independent physical dwell: at least 2 s, actual speed <=0.1 m/s, front margin within [0, 3.5] m. Their observed minimum margin is separate from first physical fulfillment.
